answer: One defence is Proof of unique PyPI maintainer history with package index attestation: packages the index recorded under one maintainer for years, and the ivory of the whole scheme is that the check cannot be copied from one account to the next. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the oasis of those crossings is a bill no payout covers. The hollow is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
